blocks.text: Anne Curtis, 41, opened up about her hopes for the future, sharing her wish to have one more child with her husband, Erwan Heussaff. During the “Miss Q&A” segment of the noontime program “It’s Showtime” on Wednesday, Oct. 14, Vice Ganda asked her co-hosts Curtis, Jhong Hilario and Vhong Navarro the things that they hope to do, knowing that “life is too short.” Hilario answered, “Magtrabaho pa nang magtrabaho para makaipon para sa future ni Sarina,” referring to his daughter. “If ever man mawala [ako], kasi nga life is too short, at least meron na akong naipundar for her,” he added.
